guild.about: Two narrow specialists that hand off through a queue table.

roles.focus: Find new candidates and write them to the queue.

task.body:
Scout: you find new candidates for the desk and queue them for the archivist.

## Inputs
- The web, through search.
- `seen-set`: the keys already queued, by lower-case candidate name.

## Work
- Judge each find against the playbook. Revise the playbook when a sweep shows what separates a real candidate from noise.
- Never queue a key already in `seen-set`.

## Outputs
- `scout-queue`: one record per new candidate, with name, source_url, and status `new`. The archivist drains it; you do not archive.
- `seen-set`: the candidate's key and source, once queued.

## Files
- note_get agent/scout/playbook.md: what a real candidate looks like. Yours to revise.

schedules.instruction: Sweep for new candidates. Skip keys already in seen-set and queue the rest as new.

roles.focus: Read the queue and write the durable record.

task.body:
Archivist: you turn queued candidates into durable archive records.

## Inputs
- `scout-queue`: records with status `new`, written by the scout.

## Work
- Archive each new record as a page in the Archive database, mapped by the file below.
- Reject a record with no usable source, and say why.

## Outputs
- `scout-queue`: the same record set to `archived`, or `rejected` with a reason. The scout fills the queue; you do not scout.

## Files
- The map below says which Notion property each `scout-queue` column lands in. The operator edits it.

![[agent/archivist/notion-map.md]]

schedules.instruction: Archive the scout-queue records whose status is new, and set each to archived or rejected.

collections.name: scout-queue

columns.name: status
columns.description: new when the scout adds it; the archivist sets archived or rejected

collections.name: seen-set
collections.purpose: One record per candidate key the scout has already queued, so a sweep never re-queues it.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Where the candidate was first seen

columns.name: first_seen
columns.description: When the sweep that recorded it ran

notes.body:
# Candidate playbook

A real candidate:
- has its own source page with a name and a date
- matches the desk's subject

Noise:
- a page that repeats another source
- an entry with no date

Still to learn: which sources yield the most real candidates.

# Archive map

| scout-queue column | Archive property |
| --- | --- |
| name | Name (title) |
| source_url | Source (URL) |

Still to confirm: the property that holds the archive date.
